findings.title: Renamed function without updating call sites
findings.body: The function was renamed from `readSensor` to `sampleSensor`, but the new name does not match the local convention of using `read` prefixes for sensor access functions (visible in the unchanged neighbouring code). This breaks consistency with the rest of the file and may confuse maintainers.

summary.problem: The renamed function breaks local naming conventions and risks confusion.
summary.done_well: The function signature and implementation remain correct and unchanged.
